verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a Workflow API, with versioned v1/v2 endpoints, that powers embedded automation experiences and 'AI workflows', and says customers can build workflows from inside a partner app. That points to programmatic workflow building, but no evidence shows endpoints for creating, updating, or turning on a Zap. The published API catalog lists only the Actions, Connections and Trigger Inbox specs, and stored actions and MCP action calls run single actions rather than managing workflows. Missing for 10: documented create/update endpoints for workflows, an activation (turn-on) endpoint, a Workflow API spec in the catalog, and hands-on evidence of an agent doing this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
